body:
Batch gate per-member credit (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-20 20:09Z, from Merger #1653 with sources).

A carried full gate settles on its launch claim only (w-f057e4c3a0b6). For a batched gate, use the host-native bind path of w-540531f46f53 (landed 7b8c085f): ONE carried gate launched on claim A binds to claim B when the SAME session holds both live claims and both name the SAME registered root and tree at launch AND at settlement. Each member then gets its own host-minted passed test record.
- Proof: verification note 6485678107bf4d95a279eaa1cc299fac and the gate note 4e8ca577b2804979b2618e193571be7e on w-540531f46f53, evaluation ee696458488241e589e0f1c1d4155fbb.
- Member-specific test criteria still need each member's own focused credited checks.
- Batches whose members are held by DIFFERENT sessions cannot use this. Hand a claim over first (with care, see coordinator-no-handoff-of-root-bound-evidence), or gate them separately.
- Legacy precedent (w-67d2 + w-030c + w-aec at 23e77889) used Greg's one-time exception instead; don't reuse it without his word.
